modules.heading: Determine the fate of the world

content.value: Travel through time to gather allies and defeat the demon god Balor. Test your tactical prowess in battle as you guide four heroes on their interwoven journeys from past to present. Together, you’ll save the future from ruin—or fall trying.
Watch Trailer
Follow the different paths of the four heroes and their allies as their tales are woven across time.

content.value: Command your units in strategic turn-based combat against the enemy. Learn the strengths and weaknesses of your units and direct them wisely on the grid-based map, and you just might gain the upper hand.

asset.alt: Theodora clenches her fist and creates sparks of lightning.

modules.heading: Turn the tide with Blaze Arts

content.value: Heroes can unleash powerful signature moves called Blaze Arts at the cost of HP. Using them fills the Blaze Gauge, which grants a helpful power boost at the halfway mark.
But be mindful—filling up the gauge completely leads to Burst, ending any bonuses and cutting the hero’s max HP in half.

asset.alt: A team of four heroes selected to take on a battle.

content.value: Earn a god’s favor, and they will bestow boons you can use to gain advantages in battle. Level up each Blessing to acquire more effects, such as temporarily reducing damage from enemy attacks.

Worthy fighters from all over the land have come to Dagsion, the capital city of the Dagdan Empire, to compete in the Heroic Games for the chance to win one wish. Among the combatants are four heroes tied to the fate of the world. Whose fortune will lead them to victory?

assets.alt: A top down shot showing one of the style of battles players may encounter.
assets.caption: A top down shot showing one of the style of battles players may encounter.

assets.alt: The stairs leading up to the main square of Dagsion are dressed in a red carpet and are flanked by rich textiles of blue, purple, green and red.
assets.caption: Gameplay showing the beautiful city of Dagsion as the four main heroes, Dietrich, Cai, Leda and Theodora run up the steps toward the Heroic Games.

content.value: Between matches, you can visit numerous locations within the city to prepare. Recruit allies around town, level up Blessings at temples, hone your skills at the training ground, build bonds of friendship at inns, and more.

asset.alt: A map showing the Dagdan Empire, the Kingdom of Arago, the Kingdom of Brezarant and the Kingdom of Saramis.

content.value: Venture out into the surrounding land to complete quests, gather resources, and defeat roaming enemies for experience.

asset.alt: Leda walking toward a glowing gold treasure chest in a dungeon.
asset.caption: Gameplay showing a battle in a dungeon led by Dietrich before the scene cuts to show Leda opening a treasure chest.

content.value: Explore Dungeons with your hero to gather materials and uncover treasure chests. Fight the monsters and ruffians lurking there in Clashes, battles where your team takes turns attacking the enemy.

asset.alt: The Silver Knight stands with his back toward the viewer as he prepares to launch another attack on Mu at the Heroic Games.
asset.caption: Gameplay of a battle between Esmerelda and the Bride's Companion cuts into footage of Mu and Silver Knight fighting in the Heroic Games.

content.value: Eventually, it will be time for you to take part in the Heroic Games and face your competitors in battle. Some matches might involve unique rules or make use of terrain, so be prepared for anything.

Product:{\"sku\":\"7100126929\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Travel through time to gather allies and defeat the demon god Balor. Test your tactical prowess in battle as you guide four heroes on their interwoven journeys from past to present. Together, you’ll save the future from ruin—or fall trying.

The Heroic Games are about to begin!

Enter the Dagdan Empire—a prosperous land ruled by the gods—and compete in the Heroic Games for the chance to be granted one wish. Powerful fighters from across the land have gathered to participate, including four heroes whose fortunes are tied to the fate of the world.

Play as Cai, a young boy determined to win the games to save his imprisoned father; Dietrich, a swordsman ever on the hunt for a stronger foe; Theodora, a queen seeking to fulfill the long-held dream of her homeland; and Leda, a musician with her sights set on revenge. The stories of these four heroes are key to this time-traveling saga of strength and steel.

Guide your heroes to victory as each weaves their own tale

Prepare for each match of the Heroic Games by exploring Dagda and its capital city of Dagsion. Learn techniques and hone skills at the training grounds, recruit allies and build bonds of friendship, and explore beyond Dagsion’s walls to gain experience and strengthen your forces in a variety of ways. How you spend your free time is up to you, but the tactical matches of the Games themselves will put your preparations to the test. Use everything you have at your disposal, including your heroes’ special abilities, to turn the tide of battle!
